about: What a generated infiltration level must satisfy when the constraint solver places it (T95). `constraints` names the rules a level is declared with, by the labels `LevelConstraintRules` gives them: drop one and it is not asked for. The first five are binary and propagated; the last five are global -- the three conditions draw-and-test already kept a level by, and two a designer wants that it could only hope for. The numbers below tune them. Each variable -- a box, a lamp, a hiding place, a patrol's route point, the sentry's post -- may take one of `candidates` places drawn from the seed. Distances are metres, steps walk cells, light 0 to 1.
constraints: the exit can be walked to
every guard place can be walked to
no post in sight of the start
a hiding place near each route
a dark way to the exit
